<description>
The `private_broadcast` fuzz test checks each tx that `GetStale()` returns. This adds to it by checking that all stale txs are returned.  `ReattemptPrivateBroadcast()` only retries what `GetStale()` returns, and a stale tx left out is never retried.

This partly came up during review in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35129#pullrequestreview-4427536924, and recently also surfaced in https://mutanthub.space/mutants/3752 , where changing `continue` to `break` in `GetStale()` passes all current tests.

This PR records when each tx is added and when each node confirms it. Then it checks that `GetStale()` returns exactly the expected txs.
</description>
